title: Radio hatch: ordinary opening, source roof exit and physical jump back into the radio seat
input_audit: Initial Radio station is ordinary scenario setup. H addresses Radio through TankInput.hatch_toggle; dismount is the ordinary public exit. There is no on_foot, foot_xz, hatch_open, mount or station-change injection. The source-supported exit point is expected 0.52 m forward of the radio aperture. A Space jump plus twelve ordinary W ticks moves approximately 0.55 m toward that opening; accepted source collision and downward plane crossing must choose Radio automatically. The current readout exposes no radio roof phase, so opening/closing attachment and lid state require visual review. A changed exit support must produce a review failure, never a corrective teleport.
visual_acceptance: H operates the original MG Operater roof subtree and its separate live eyepiece.
The source roof supports the dismounted soldier at a standing human height.
The jump descends through the radio operator's aperture, returning to Radio without crossing sealed armor.
At 5 seconds, H closes the radio hatch rather than the cupola or driver's hatch.
